top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers had expired CPR and Fist Aid certification.

top_violation_types.title: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine (26 TAC §746.623(2)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's immunization record did not have the signature (including a rubber stamp or electronic signature) of the health-care professional who administered the vaccine.

top_violation_types.title: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  - 6 Foot High (26 TAC §746.5007(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fencing around the swimming pool is 5 feet and 10 inches.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post (26 TAC §746.401(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit renewal notice was not posted.    This was corrected at inspection when the permit renewal notice was printed and posted.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.
